verdict.rationale: Zapier documents that Zap workflows connect with 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions through prebuilt integrations. Product vendors build and publish their integrations to Zapier's App Directory. Community users independently confirm a large and growing integration catalog. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that published integrations are kept up to date by the app vendors after publishing.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Zap workflows can connect with 9,000+ apps
It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions
Build a Zapier integration - design triggers and actions for your product, wire up authentication, then publish to the App Directory.
Zapier has about 1,000 integrations, more than any of their closest competitors
I pay for Zapier and sometimes I end up on these pages when searching simply because I was unaware of a new integration.
